rows.grounds: compound listing harmful forces; neuter plural object of nāśayet
expresses the intended effect of the prescribed worship
refers to the practitioner performing the rite

items.question: Which malevolent forces can the practitioner eliminate through the prescribed daily worship?
premises: The practitioner performs the prescribed daily worship.
Malevolent forces include sorcery disease fear malice and spirits.
The prescribed worship possesses the power to destroy such forces.
items.inference: Therefore the practitioner can destroy these malevolent forces through that worship.
uncertainties: bhūtāni may refer broadly to beings or specifically to hostile spirits.
items.plain_english: This practitioner should destroy sorcery, disease, fear, malice, and hostile spirits.
